# Atomic Leap Ltd — Comprehensive Technical Specification & Engineering Codex

> Sovereign Venture Studio & Senior Engineering Advisory based in London, United Kingdom.
> Atomic Leap builds, operates, and scales high-performance software systems for ambitious B2B technology companies.

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Sovereign Philosophy

Atomic Leap Ltd is an independent B2B engineering advisory and venture studio established in 2019 in London, UK.

### Sovereign Software Architecture
We operate under the core doctrine of **sovereign software architecture**:
- **Full Infrastructure Control:** Clients retain 100% ownership and governance of their cloud environments, source code, data pipelines, and secrets.
- **Zero Vendor Lock-in:** Portable, self-hosted infrastructure components built with open standards, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud-agnostic Infrastructure as Code (AWS CDK, Terraform).
- **Data Sovereignty:** No proprietary third-party black-box dependencies. Data assets remain strictly within client-controlled boundaries.
- **Defensible Metrics:** Engineering solutions backed by concrete, production-tested benchmarks and mathematical guarantees (e.g., double-entry idempotency, sub-50ms ledger processing, sub-second vector retrieval).

---

## 2. Core Engagement Model & Capabilities

Atomic Leap engages with high-growth B2B technology companies, fintechs, media networks, and venture-backed startups across three primary operational models:

1. **Venture Building (`01. BUILD`):** Conceptualizing, designing, and engineering proprietary B2B software products (BearAudit, Audit-Bay).
2. **Systems Architecture & Scale (`02. SCALE`):** Re-architecting legacy monoliths into distributed microservices, optimizing database performance, and implementing high-throughput message buses.
3. **Deterministic AI & Infrastructure (`03. INTELLIGENCE`):** Implementing production-grade RAG pipelines, fine-tuned LLM execution environments, vector databases, and FinOps cloud cost reduction.

---

## 3. Engineering Pillars & Technology Stack

### Pillar 01: Distributed Systems & Microservices
- **Languages:** Go (Golang), TypeScript / Node.js, Python 3.11+, Rust (for high-performance compute primitives).
- **Relational Databases:** PostgreSQL (ACID compliance, custom partitioning, pgvector, row-level security), MySQL.
- **In-Memory & Caching:** Redis (Pub/Sub, Rate Limiting, Redlock distributed locking, memory caching).
- **Event Streaming & Message Queues:** Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, NATS.
- **API Protocols:** RESTful APIs, gRPC (Protobuf), GraphQL, WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE).

### Pillar 02: Financial Ledgers & Transaction Processing
- **Ledger Design:** Strictly immutable double-entry bookkeeping ledgers ensuring continuous balance sheet equilibrium (`sum(debits) - sum(credits) = 0`).
- **Payment Gateway Protocols:** Faster Payments (UK), Open Banking APIs, ISO 20022 message formats, Stripe Connect, Bacs.
- **Concurrency & Idempotency:** Distributed locking via Redis/PostgreSQL, deterministic idempotency keys, sub-50ms transaction throughput.

### Pillar 03: Production AI & Vector Search
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Deterministic multi-stage retrieval pipelines combining dense vector embeddings with sparse keyword search (BM25 / TF-IDF).
- **Vector Stores:** Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector, Pinecone.
- **LLM Orchestration:** Custom Python/TypeScript frameworks, LangChain/LlamaIndex isolation wrappers, vLLM local model serving, OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic API integration.
- **Evaluation & Guardrails:** Automated evaluation harnesses (lm-eval, Ragas), toxicity/hallucination filtering, input sanitization, prompt injection defense.

### Pillar 04: Cloud Infrastructure & FinOps
- **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python), Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation.
- **Cloud Providers:** Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Hetzner Bare Metal.
- **Container Orchestration:** Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), AWS ECS/Fargate, Docker Compose, s6-overlay container supervision.
- **FinOps & Cost Optimization:** Systematic architectural audits reducing cloud compute/storage spend through reserved instances, spot instances, graviton arm processing, and serverless auto-scaling.

### Pillar 05: Real-Time Media & Broadcast Engineering
- **Streaming Protocols:** Low-latency HLS (HTTP Live Streaming), RTMP (Real-Time Messaging Protocol), SRT (Secure Reliable Transport), WebRTC.
- **Video Processing:** Transcoding, adaptive bitrate (ABR) encoding, FFmpeg custom pipelines, AWS Elemental MediaLive/MediaPackage.
- **Syndication & OTT:** TV feed syndication to major Smart TV channels (Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS).

---

## 4. Active Ventures & Products

Atomic Leap builds and operates proprietary software ventures targeting critical B2B bottlenecks:

### 1. BearAudit
- **Domain:** [https://bearaudit.com](https://bearaudit.com)
- **Description:** AI-powered automated code review, static security analysis, dependency vulnerability scanning, and automated pull-request remediation.
- **Key Capabilities:** Integrates into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), scans codebases for OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, enforces code style standards, and suggests automated refactoring diffs.

### 2. Audit-Bay
- **Domain:** [https://audit-bay.com](https://audit-bay.com)
- **Description:** Automated web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA / AAA) and legal compliance testing platform for modern web applications.
- **Key Capabilities:** Continuous accessibility audits, automated ARIA state checking, keyboard navigation simulation, screen reader compatibility validation, and automated compliance risk reporting.

### 3. Subjct
- **Role:** Client Partner & Co-engineered Infrastructure
- **Description:** Enterprise AI content ingestion, automated classification, and RAG vector orchestration platform built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and dense vector search.

---

## 5. Architectural Case Studies & Production Proofs

### Case Study A: Santander UK Payment Hub & Double-Entry Ledger
- **Scale:** Processing £50M+ in daily transaction volume across Faster Payments and core banking rails.
- **Challenge:** Guaranteeing zero balance sheet drift under high concurrent transaction spikes while maintaining strict sub-50ms latency SLAs.
- **Architecture:** Engineered a Go-based microservice architecture coupled with a PostgreSQL immutable double-entry ledger. Utilized deterministic Redis distributed locks (`Redlock`), sequence-numbered ledger event logs, and row-level database locking to enforce strict linearizability.

### Case Study B: High-Concurrency Live Stream Network (Lounges.tv)
- **Scale:** Ultra-low-latency live broadcasts streaming high-profile artists (Brian Cox, Nile Rodgers, Sarkodie) to global audiences and Smart TV channels.
- **Challenge:** Ingesting RTMP/SRT feeds with dynamic adaptive bitrate transcoding and syndicating feeds across OTT platforms with minimal buffering.
- **Architecture:** Constructed an AWS-backed video processing pipeline utilizing AWS Elemental MediaLive, FFmpeg edge nodes, and global CloudFront CDN distributions. Integrated real-time creator monetization and ticketing mechanics.

### Case Study C: SkillMatch Enterprise ATS Engine v5.1
- **Domain:** Advanced candidate CV analysis, job description matching, and PDF generation engine.
- **Challenge:** Replacing generic keyword matching with dynamic N-gram keyphrase extraction, TF-IDF weighting, action verb power rating, and metric density evaluation.
- **Architecture:** Built a hybrid Python FastAPI server integrated with Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for contextual rewriting, Node.js PDF generation pipelines, and visual Markdown diff comparisons.
